name: How long does a typical accessible bathroom renovation take?

mainEntity.name: How long does a typical accessible bathroom renovation take?

acceptedAnswer.text: The duration of an accessible bathroom renovation depends on its complexity. Simple modifications, like installing grab bars or a new toilet, might take a day or two. More extensive projects, such as converting a bathtub to a walk-in shower, can take 1 to 3 weeks. A complete gut and remodel for full accessibility can extend to 3-6 weeks or more, depending on material availability, inspections, and the specific modifications required.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation time varies: a day or two for simple modifications, 1-3 weeks for shower conversions, and 3-6+ weeks for a complete accessible remodel.
